name: vic-testing
description: Standalone Test Creation & Execution module (Areas E/F): writing generated test files to disk (reusing vic-coding's write-scope gate), the module/element-scoped test-execution gate, mechanical test running, the requirement-status pass-threshold flip, and full regression orchestration. Depends on vic-requirements-elicitation for the Project/TestCase data model, vic-coding for the shared source tree/scaffold/git helpers and the scoping gate, and vic-llm-claude-code for the agentic test-file-writing client.
